title: Testing strategy and secrets management
summary: Add unit and integration tests to your database pipeline and manage secrets safely.

items: Design unit and integration tests for database code.

blocks.body: Reliable deployments need tests and secrets that never live in the repo.

terms.definition: Validates a single object's behavior (e.g., a stored procedure) in isolation.
Storing credentials/keys outside code (e.g., Key Vault, GitHub secrets).

blocks.body: Write **unit tests** for procedures/functions and **integration tests** that exercise the deployed schema. Keep credentials in a secrets store (Azure Key Vault, GitHub Actions secrets) referenced by the pipeline — never commit secrets.
Reference secrets from Key Vault via Managed Identity in pipelines; rotate regularly.

tips: Never store connection strings/keys in the project — use a secret store.
Integration tests run against a deployed copy.

blocks.body: Test database code (unit + integration) and keep every secret in a managed store, referenced at deploy time.
